status.summary: Former UFC welterweight champion, pro record 24-6 (1 NC). He won the title from Leon Edwards at UFC 304 (Jul 27, 2024) and lost it to Jack Della Maddalena at UFC 315 in Montreal (May 10, 2025; 47-48, 47-48, 46-49). Since then he has lost two more decisions: Ian Machado Garry (UD, Doha, Nov 22, 2025) and Gabriel Bonfim (45-50 x3 in a five-round main event, Las Vegas, Jun 6, 2026). That is three straight losses, at age 38. Outside MMA he has wrestled in Real American Freestyle (RAF): he beat Ben Askren 6-3 at RAF 11 (Milwaukee, Jul 18, 2026) and lost a 10-0 technical fall to Colby Covington for the RAF cruiserweight crossover title at RAF 13 (Miami, Sep 18, 2026). No UFC fight booked, and no injury or retirement announcement found, as of Nov 6, 2026.

style.summary: A pressure wrestle-boxer who wins on volume, cardio and control rather than power. He throws well above the welterweight average, mixes in takedowns and gets busier as fights go on, but he has never scored a UFC knockdown. Since winning the title he has lost three straight decisions to fighters who stopped his takedowns and out-landed him at range.

moves.notes: Target split from the fighters.json S sums: decayed significant attempts go 87.9% head, 9.3% body, 2.8% legs, and landed strikes 77.9% head, 16.3% body, 5.8% legs. Career attempts are 86.6/9.1/4.3. Nearly all his output is punches to the head at distance (91% of decayed landed strikes at distance, 4.5% in the clinch), so head-punch weights are high and kicks are near zero. His leg attempts are under a third of the welterweight rate (9.3%). Body attempts are below the division rate (13.9%) but land well (16.3% of landed; 39/41 against Burns), so the three body moves share about 0.4 and lean to punches. ufcstats does not split jab, cross and hook. Jab and cross lead as a judgment from his high-volume straight-punch style, not a count. Spinning is 0, and head kicks and elbows near 0, because none appear in his finishes or the scouting data. The Nov 6, 2026 web pass re-checked status and appearance only; these technique weights still rest on ufcstats alone, with no outside technique breakdown.

engine_notes.note: No power: 0 knockdowns in 22 UFC fights. His two UFC KO/TKO wins (Montano 2016, Brady 2022) came without a recorded knockdown.

Late surge is credible: five-round pace (1, 1.20, 1.16, 1.52, 1.61) is built on 25 min in each of rounds 2-5 across 5-6 fights. Opponents also land more on him late (5.32 absorbed per min and 57.6% accuracy in round 5), so late rounds get busier both ways.
Chin: 6 knockdowns absorbed in his career, all from 2016-2019 (Jouban 3, Luque 1, Neal 2). None in 263 head strikes absorbed over the last 3 years. 1 KO loss (Luque, 2016).
Decline signal: 0-3 since May 2025, strike differential -0.92 per minute over the last 3 years (career +0.44), and 0/9 takedowns in his last two fights.

RAF freestyle wrestling (not MMA, not in the engine data): beat Ben Askren 6-3 (Jul 2026), then lost a 10-0 technical fall to Colby Covington (Sep 2026). That fits the 0/9 takedowns in his last two UFC fights as a sign his offensive wrestling edge has faded against strong wrestlers.
